title: S0: Audit Uniform2 training-seed reuse from324 through600
doing: Audit saved seed configurations and complete training start/episode journals for Uniform2 from parent324 through600. Separate retained ancestry, discarded interrupted work, and startup/reset/terminal episodes; report unique seeds and episodes per seed without simulator or training execution.
expected: Before this retrospective data audit: the fixed512 pool likely persisted through Uniform2 and its recovery; unique seeds should be at most512 per segment, with repeated episodes. Missing start journals would limit exact episode counts rather than justify inferred counts.
actual: All512 pool seeds were reused throughout retained Uniform2 ancestry:18,550 episode starts and17,846 completions, averaging36.23 starts and34.86 completions per unique seed. Continuation420 is cumulative852; the27.5M-frame estimate covers its420 continuation updates, not its complete ancestry.
why: Exact journaled resets/completions and constructor seeds derived from the pinned hash stream match the same512-pool throughout. This establishes limited seed diversity, not that reuse caused the plateau; discarded interrupted work is counted separately.
next_step: Use S1 to measure pipeline cost; propose fresh-stream S3 with a matched pool control before any new training.
